layout_reasoning: Large navy serif type, pine secondary text and generous cream space preserve the restrained New England identity.
The user's own closing thought carries the story without diagnosis-led promotion or a claim about therapeutic results.
The title and family/Minute Man subtitle are readable as a standalone invitation to the story.
The tall graphic keeps all essential text within a 220-pixel top and 280-pixel bottom safe area; this is a design choice, not a platform-wide guarantee.
The graphics are publication-created promotional text cards, distinct from documentary family photographs and functional communication cards.

scoped_organic_sharing_intent.permitted_intended_use: Share these two exact finished PNGs unchanged in organic social posts or Stories, retaining all embedded text and An AUsome Life credit. Accompany each shared graphic with An AUsome Life / @anausomelife credit and a link to https://anausomelife.com/minute-man-walk-great-aunt-susan.html.
scoped_organic_sharing_intent.scope_limits: Only the two named finished PNGs are covered. No rights are granted to family photographs, other website images or downloads, the archive, third-party logos, source files, edits, paid advertising, merchandising, or presentation as an official park partnership or endorsement. No rights beyond those controlled by the publication are granted.
scoped_organic_sharing_intent.authorization_basis: Current-session owner-directed publication and sharing package, plus the standing requirement to prepare reviewed original social assets for each comparable outing story. These are newly authored typographic compositions with no third-party imagery.

No photographs or illustrations appear.
